article.title: Okeyode joins APC at Akure rally
article.text: Senator Barnabas Okeyode, who represents Ondo Demo District 1, on Monday formally joined the All Progressives Congress at a rally in Akure. The senator had resigned his membership of the Peoples Democratic Party in a letter to his ward chairman last week. "I have today joined the APC to better serve my people," Okeyode told the crowd. The APC national chairman presented him with a membership card.
